ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a schematic diagram of a food chain, titled “Food Chain”. The arrows sequentially show Sun pointing to Leaves, Leaves pointing to Cricket, Cricket pointing to Frog, Frog pointing to Snake, Snake pointing to Hawk, and Hawk pointing to Mushrooms. Reasoning: The arrows in the food chain indicate that energy or food is transferred from the previous organism to the next organism. Because in the diagram the arrow after Frog points to Snake, it shows that the snake depends on the frog as a food source. If the frog population disappears due to disease or natural disaster, the snake will lose an important food source, therefore the snake population will be negatively affected.
